original.target_description: Study 3: awe versus neutral video; between-condition t test of log-transformed strengths-to-weaknesses ratio, measuring balance in presentation to others.

n.sample_role: Participants in the stated final analytic sample for Study 3.
n.exclusions: Fourteen did not follow writing directions; four listed strengths/weaknesses more than 3 SDs from the mean. Printed final N is retained despite inconsistency with initial 104 and t(84).

replication.target_description: Study 1 direct replication of Stellar Study 3: awe versus neutral video; between-condition t test of log-transformed humility ratio (strengths divided by weaknesses).

n.sample_role: Participants contributing nonmissing transformed humility ratios; exact analytic n not explicitly printed.
n.exclusions: 94 completed the study; zero weaknesses led to exclusions from some log-transformed computations. Outcome-specific exclusion counts and analytic n are not given. Not inferred from degrees of freedom.
n.quote: All available participant data was used to run the analyses.

es.location: p. 41, Results, humility score; p. 45, Appendix D, Figure 1

p.location: p. 41, Results, humility score; p. 45, Appendix D, Figure 1

reported_success.quote: the failure to directly replicate the original study

notes: The presentation-of-strengths-and-weaknesses target is operationalized as the primary balance/ratio outcome, not the separately reported strengths-only or weaknesses-only follow-up tests. Statistics preserved as printed; no metric conversions. Original PDF browser parse uses corrupted glyphs for some operators; the same original t and p are explicitly reprinted in the replication p. 41. Original stated analytic N=85 conflicts with df=84 and initial N minus described exclusions; retained without correction. Replication analytic n is not recovered from df or generic recruited N.
